decisions.summary: Split GitHub planning truth from Aiur runtime activity
decisions.rationale: Each system owns different facts and neither may overwrite the other.

decisions.summary: Use labeled root issues and direct native sub-issues
decisions.rationale: Stable selectable membership avoids per-feature labels and a second planning database.

decisions.summary: Use native blockedBy as the only hard dependency truth
decisions.rationale: Native relationships and completed-only satisfaction prevent prose and progress drift.

decisions.summary: Keep phase lane and complexity metadata strict and single-valued
decisions.rationale: Ambiguity remains visible as a warning rather than a silently selected value.

decisions.summary: Publish only complete atomic last-known-good graph generations
decisions.rationale: Partial provider responses must never make dependencies disappear.

decisions.summary: Keep StatusReport lifecycle ownership and move only event activity out of AgentList
decisions.rationale: Headless and interactive consumers need one typed daemon-owned projection.

decisions.summary: Use accessible DOM cards with a vendored layout-only worker
decisions.rationale: A maintained engine computes geometry while BO-010 applies it, BO-013 owns fit/pan/zoom interaction, BO-014 hardens scale, and Aiur retains semantics and product state.

decisions.summary: Keep GitHub planning read-only in v1
decisions.rationale: GitHub remains authoritative; Build Order invokes no mutating Aiur action and may only link to destination surfaces with independent contracts.

decisions.summary: Keep dashboard catch-up and accounting outside Build Order
decisions.rationale: Standalone presentation and financial work cannot alter the bounded feature terminal condition.

decisions.summary: Treat phase as presentation and rollout guidance only
decisions.rationale: Readiness comes from dependencies outcomes health conflicts and capacity.
Planning publishes truth and routing metadata but leaves activation to the later Executor.

decisions.summary: Protect the finite feature boundary during execution
decisions.rationale: Contained rework and deferred findings prevent legitimate discoveries from creating an endless run.

decisions.summary: Gate execution on the actual OCC integration baseline and bounded Executor skills
decisions.rationale: The researched main baseline and configured v2 target diverge and the current installed Executor contract predates the bounded rewrite.
